basic_info.description: With breathtaking views of the Golden Gate Bridge, Bay and Marin Headlands, this tastefully remodeled condo sits atop a handsome, Edwardian building in the Lake Street neighborhood, offering an enviable blend of city living - a neighborly vibe plus easy proximity to iconic natural and cultural treasures plus world class dining. Awash in natural day light and featuring generously proportioned rooms, this upper unit seamlessly blends original architectural details with current amenities. High ceilings, hardwood floors, a wood-burning fireplace, and striking moldings harmonize with modern electrical wiring, a custom designed kitchen, updated baths and period-style hardware. The well-appointed, chef's kitchen features custom cabinetry designed to honor the original architectural style, stainless steel appliances, ample counters and abundant storage. The laundry and stairs to the lovely shared garden are located in the kitchen. Two large bedrooms and an office/sunroom look to panoramic views of the Golden Gate Bridge, Bay and Marin Headlands. A third bedroom, one full bath and one half bath offer convenience and flexibility. The garage offer one-car parking and storage. Located on a tree-lined block on coveted Lake Street nestled between the Presidio and Land's End
